digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center test harness
propositions: No purchasable Jira Data Center license or official OpenAPI spec exists, so a DC adapter cannot be verified against a real oracle.
Use the pinned pycontribs/jira-test-image:8.17.1 Docker image as a licensed local Jira DC instance reachable at http://localhost:2990/jira.
Personal Access Token bearer auth is exercised against the real instance since 8.17.1 is >=8.14, proving the DC transport auth mode.
Teardown asserts each delete's HTTP status and polls the direct issue REST endpoint until 404, never consulting the lagging search index, per ADR 0037 §3.
All tests carry the existing integration marker so make test excludes them by construction with no Makefile test-target change.
The harness proves REST v2 protocol semantics only, not deployment-specific behavior, with real-instance validation tracked separately in ticket 9895-ac7d-4276-4f08.
